silhouette.reason: A stepped test-card stand: twelve rows of strip panels rising toward the back, the decal and foliage cells on the top row. Every panel is visible from the 3/4 view.

proportions.reason: Each of the 42 strips is one true-scale repeat wide (stripRect(id).metres: 4 / 16 / 32 m) and its design height tall, so texel density can be judged directly against the 1.8 m figure.

materials.reason: All 42 strips (classic, library, nature) render with their own albedo/normal/ORM: metals reflect, wood shows grain, cobbles and cliff show relief, glass is transparent, foliage cells cut out.
fixes: add a sphere per strip at LOD0 for curvature/roughness reading (docs/media/materials.png does this)

detail.reason: Labels in block letters on every plinth face; at hero distance the labels are too small to read for the long nature rows.
fixes: scale label pixel size with the row's panel width

wear.reason: A test card is deliberately clean: weathering would contaminate the strip read. Weathering variants are shown by weather_demo.

lod.reason: LOD1/LOD2 keep every panel (778 triangles) but drop labels.

technical.reason: QA PASS, 27 288 / 778 / 778 (labels are the LOD0 cost), three draws (opaque, glass, cutout).
fixes: merge label pixel runs per word to cut LOD0 triangles
